entities.summary: Rada Akbar, is an Afghan-born conceptual artist, and photographer. The focus of her artwork has been to denounce the oppression of women, and ask the world to see the strength of Afghan women through her artwork and photographic portraits. She was chosen as one of the BBC's 100 most influential women of 2021.
